page.layout: One page of text in a single column; margin notes at left (Zonar., Tomo 3, Sigebertus in Chron., Cedrenus) and some notes at right edge; running head at top; page number at top.
page.running_head: Philippicus Bardan. Artemius &c. Lib. IV. A.

main_text.l: fere imperia fuêre. Ille cùm & Monothelelita-
vaftare, Saracenos verò Antiochiam Pisidiæ oc-
cupare, permitteret; in odium Procerum vellet,
atque ab illorum duobus, ut fomno indulge-
ret e convivio digressus, domi suæ luminibus,
anno imperii secundo, privatus est; Artemio Se-
Artemius, qui & Anastasius II dici debuit, cum
Saracenos classem in Phœnicia instruere, quam
præventendos ratus, tum civibus de com-
meatu sibi in triennium prospicere, & qua-
re ardtiori essent, emigrare imperavit: tum
Classiarios, igni marino armatos ire jussit, ut
rii, ex his audentiores, Johannem Diaconum,
pro imperio eos alloquentem Rhodi confode-
metribus praeliis Artemianos fatigavit, ac tan-
dem proditione quorundam in Urbem admissus,

marginalia.note: Zonar. Tomo 3. Sigebertus in Chron. Cedrenus.

page.notes: Several marginal and edge words are damaged or cut off at the right edge (e.g., "Bulgaros", "civibus", "instruere", "admissus", "Gothorum"); readings there are uncertain. Right-edge notes are partly illegible.
